findings.title: Loss of precision when converting cents back to euros
findings.body: `toCents` converts an amount in euros to whole cents, but `depositCents` calls it on a rounded cent value. This discards any fractional cents that were already present in the euro amount, leading to a loss of precision. Compute the deposit in cents directly without converting to euros first.

findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic on cents
findings.body: Multiplying `totalCents(booking)` (an integer) by a percentage expressed as a float (`percent / 100`) can introduce floating-point rounding errors. Use integer arithmetic to avoid this: multiply first, then divide by 100.

summary.problem: The new `depositCents` function introduces precision loss and potential floating-point errors in monetary calculations.
summary.done_well: The function reuses existing utilities (`totalCents`, `toCents`) and keeps the code concise.
